heading: How return values become responses
body: An ordinary return value becomes JSON. A response in the language's own type controls status, headers and body, such as a Fetch `Response` in JavaScript, `http::Response` in Rust or `HttpResponseMessage` in C#. Yon sends HTML only when the controller method itself selects `Content-Type: text/html`. Yon passes those bytes through unchanged. It does no interpolation (filling values into text), no component expansion, no control-tag evaluation and no server-side rendering. Tachyon rejects a `yon.html` file with TY1008.
